create_index_parse_translation_unit: create an Index and parse a C/C++ source file into a TranslationUnit AST
build_code_completion: build code completion results for a given file position with unsaved file contents
review_diagnostics: review diagnostics from a TranslationUnit to report errors, warnings, and fix-its
walk_cursor_ast: walk the AST preorder from a TranslationUnit cursor to visit all child nodes
get_tokens_from_range: get tokens from a SourceRange within a TranslationUnit for lexical analysis
